sections.title: S1: WARM UP
sections.description:
Warm up 

a. Dynamic stretches
1 round of:
60/60 sec Dynamic Pec Stretch
60/60 sec Dynamic Lat Stretch
60 sec Anterior stretch (hands on bar)
15 Plate Pull overs (10/5kg | 25/10lbs)

b. Metabolic prep
4 minutes Ski performed as 20 sec Easy / 10 sec Hard

c. Activation
25 Banded Pull aparts
25 Banded Tricep extensions
25 Banded Bicep curls
25 Banded Delt raises
25 Banded Face pulls

d. Specific prep (Wall Walk, Wall Facing HSPU, Strict Toes to bar)
Self directed or use below as guideline:
5 Inchworm push ups
15 Seated Pike raises
20 sec Wall facing HS hold
15 Toe reaches
5 Pike HSPU
+ 5 minutes to practice full Wall Walks, Wall Facing HSPUs, Strict Toes to bar)

attachments.title: Lat pulsed stretching with reach through
Core piece (Rus. twist, heel tap, toe reaches)

sections.title: S1: RELATIVE STRENGTH ENDURANCE (GYM.)
sections.description:
(Relative) Strength Endurance / Gymnastics

Elite:
a. 10 minute AMRAP for quality:
1 Wall Walk
2 Wall Facing HSPU
4 Strict Toes to bar

RX:
a. 10 minute AMRAP for quality:
1 Wall Walk
1 Wall Facing HSPU
2 Strict Toes to bar

Intermediate:
a. 10 minute AMRAP for quality:
1 Wall Walk (Reduced Distance variation if needed)
2 Pike HSPU
4 Strict Hanging L-raises
----------------------------------

sections.title: S1: CONDITIONING
sections.description:
Conditioning, “Raising the ceiling” (Threshold │ 80-85% effort │ Heavy-Severe intensity domain)

Elite:
a. 5 sets, Going every 5th minute
50 Double unders 
5 Ring Muscle ups
25 KB swings (24/16kg)
25 Toes to rings
+ C2 Bike at recovery pace in the remaining time

RX:
a. 5 sets, Going every 5th minute
40 Double unders 
4 Ring Muscle ups
20 KB swings (24/16kg)
20 Toes to rings
+ C2 Bike at recovery pace in the remaining time

Intermediate:
a. 5 sets, Going every 5th minute
30 Double unders or 90 Single unders
3 Ring Muscle ups or 6 Ring dips
15 KB swings (24/16kg)
15 Toes to rings
+ C2 Bike at recovery pace in the remaining time

Scaled:
Spend 20 minutes working through our ring muscle up progressions found in the attached files.

Score: Total accumulated time across the 5 sets. (Make sure to put a comment with what level you completed the workout at)

sections.title: S1: (TEAM VERSION) CONDITIONING
sections.description:
Note: One of the reasons most of us fall in love with CrossFit is the community aspect.
It’s being surrounded by others whom are like minded in an environment that brings out the best in us.
Pushing hard in training with a group can for some feel more enjoyable and can often give that extra kick needed to perform better.
The "Team Edition" add-ons to the program is for those who wishes to do team competitions now and in the future.
This will give those of you who might consider going team a structured session that will be based around synchro coordination, team workouts, relays & worm specific training. All elements that are key in creating a successful team.

It can be hard to coordinate training with 3 others and the program is therefore build in a way that the team session fits in with the rest of the weekly program, so that we make sure you hit everything you need to weekly.

This piece is to be done instead of the original engine piece.
_________________________________________
Conditioning

a. 5 sets, Going every 5th minute
50 Double unders (each) (Mix Pair #1) | 5 Sync. Ring Muscle ups (Mix Pair #2) 
5 Sync. Ring Muscle ups (Mix Pair #1) | 50 Double unders (each) (Mix Pair #2)
25 Sync. KB swings (24/16kg) (Mix Pair #1) | 25 Sync. Toes to rings  (Mix Pair #2)
25 Sync. Toes to rings  (Mix Pair #1) | 25 Sync. KB swings (24/16kg) (Mix Pair #2)

sections.title: S2: CONDITIONING
sections.description:
Conditioning "Building the basement" (60-65% effort / “Easy” / Moderate intensity domain / Z2)

a. 5-4-3-2-1k C2 Bike (♀ 4-3.2-2.4-1.6-0.8k)
50/40 Cal Ski between each set
Intensity: "Building the basement" (60-65% effort / “Easy” / Moderate intensity domain / Z2)

Flow explained:
5/4k C2 bike, 50/40 Cal Ski, 4/3.2k C2 Bike, 50/40 Cal Ski, 3/2.4k C2 Bike, 50/40 Cal Ski, 2/1.6k C2 Bike, 50/40 Cal Ski, 1/0.8k C2 Bike.
